decisions.quote: We followed the analysis steps of the original study as closely as possible and obtained extremely high canonical correlations (0.99 and 0.97) and optimal 3 cluster solution. However, after performing additional tests that were not performed in the original study, which took into account that the RS-fMRI connectivity features were selected based on their correlation with clinical features before performing CCA on these connectivity and clinical features, even the high canonical correlations that we observed were not statistically significant and they did not replicate outside of the training set.
decisions.reason: Following the original study's analytical pipeline and significance testing reproduced the apparent findings (high canonical correlations with analytical p < 0.0001 and an optimal cluster solution), but the authors' main conclusion is that the original methodology is statistically flawed due to overfitting from feature pre-selection and clustering heuristics that yield apparent clusters even from a single Gaussian distribution.
